- Fried potato cubes: 6 visible pieces, each about 2.5 cm, with a few hidden under the mound. Count about 7 pieces at about 25 g each (cooked, roast potato chunks) = about 150 g... on reflection, each piece is about 2.5 cm cube (≈ 10-12 g raw-cooked size), so 7 × 12 g ≈ 85 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: no base layer is visible under the egg; the plate surface is bare. No extra items added.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g:
- Scrambled egg (with a little butter): about 150 kcal/100 g.
- Fried/roasted potato: about 130 kcal/100 g.

Totals: egg 154 g → 231 kcal; potato 85 g → 111 kcal. Total about 240 g, about 342 kcal.
